agents.name: Fund distribution evidence assistant
agents.summary: Review supplied changes, preserve the last evidence baseline and return only affected calculations and unresolved approval questions.
agents.need: Actual no-catchup LPA, constant eligible capital interval, dated accrual basis, unpaid opening preference, distributable cash and residual carry fraction. For terminal carry review include independently verified final whole-fund entitlement, actual prior carry paid, permitted tax deductions, recoveries and escrow. Supply the previous approved review and actual changed source files with dates.
agents.trigger: A distribution proposal, dated preference record, final entitlement notice or actual GP carry recovery changes.
agents.branch: If a terminal entitlement review is supplied, compare actual paid carry with that independently verified whole-fund entitlement and collateral. Do not treat one current distribution carry amount as final lifetime entitlement. Otherwise skip clawback and keep the current distribution scenario separate from executed payments.
agents.memory: LPA version, eligible capital periods, unpaid preference, no-catchup confirmation, actual-versus-proposed cash, paid carry ledger, final entitlement source and collateral evidence.
agents.schedule: On explicit request after the user supplies changed evidence. Installing the pack creates no schedule or account connection.
agents.acceptance: Use only the supported simple-accrual no-catchup structure; record any compounding, GP capital or catch-up as a blocker. Never overwrite an accepted baseline with an unapproved scenario; record which branch ran or was skipped.
agents.deliverable: Preference accrual, capital and preference payments, residual GP/LP cash and unpaid senior tiers. Include changed inputs, source versions, branch reasons and checks still blocked.

distinctFrom.why: Reviews contractual fund distribution tiers and carry recovery rather than grant budget classifications.
